risk.rationale: A customer-support chatbot interacting directly with natural persons. It does not make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects and does not match any Annex III use case; transparency obligations under Art. 50 apply.
triggers: Art. 50(1): direct interaction with natural persons

requirements.title: No emotion recognition in workplace context
requirements.statement: The system does not infer emotions of candidates or employees from biometric or behavioural signals.

requirements.title: Risk class documented and justified
requirements.statement: The repository documents the AI Act risk class of the system with an explicit justification referencing Art. 6 / Annex III.
requirements.llm_guidance: Check whether the document states a risk class and justifies it against Annex III use cases.

requirements.title: Users informed they interact with an AI
requirements.statement: Natural persons interacting with a conversational interface are informed they are interacting with an AI system.
requirements.llm_guidance: Disclosure must be shown before or at the start of the interaction.

requirements.title: Machine-readable marking of generated content
requirements.statement: Generated text outputs are marked as AI-generated in a machine-readable form (metadata or watermark).
requirements.llm_guidance: Look for response metadata flags, headers or content credentials indicating AI generation.

requirements.title: Automatic logging of AI decisions
requirements.statement: The system automatically records events (inputs, outputs, timestamps) for each model decision.
requirements.llm_guidance: Look for logging of model inputs/outputs with timestamps for every prediction.

requirements.title: Human reviewer can override AI output
requirements.statement: A human reviewer can disregard, override or reverse every automated decision before it takes effect.
requirements.llm_guidance: Check that rejection decisions are routed to a human, not only borderline scores.

requirements.title: PII minimised before third-party processing
requirements.statement: Personal data is redacted or minimised before being sent to third-party model providers.
requirements.llm_guidance: Check the code path that calls the external LLM API for redaction of names, emails, phone numbers.

requirements.title: Personal data deleted after retention period
requirements.statement: Personal data is automatically deleted or anonymised after a defined retention period.
requirements.llm_guidance: Verify that every store of personal data has a retention/deletion mechanism.

requirements.title: Privacy notice shown at collection
requirements.statement: Data subjects are shown a privacy notice (controller, purposes, legal basis, recipients) when their data is collected.

requirements.title: Encryption of personal data at rest
requirements.statement: Storage holding personal data is encrypted at rest.

requirements.title: No hard-coded secrets
requirements.statement: No API keys, passwords or tokens are committed to the repository.

requirements.title: Prompt logs redact PII
requirements.statement: Prompt/completion logs redact personal data before persistence.
requirements.llm_guidance: Check the logging middleware around LLM calls for redaction.

verdicts.rationale: The assistant answers order and shipping questions; no emotion inference or biometric processing exists in the codebase.
docs/ai-act.md classifies the system as limited risk with a justification (not an Annex III use case, Art. 50 applies) and a review date.
The chat window renders a persistent disclosure ('You're chatting with Northwind's AI assistant') above the conversation, before the first message.

The API response includes a 'generated: true' field, which is machine-readable, but it is not propagated into transcripts or exported content, and no standard (e.g. C2PA/IPTC) is used. Whether this suffices for chat text is unsettled.
gaps: Marking not persisted with stored/exported answers.
verdicts.remediation: Persist an ai_generated flag with assistant messages and include it in any export (e.g. email transcripts) using a documented metadata field.

verdicts.rationale: Applies to high-risk systems only; the system is classified as limited risk.
Applies to high-risk systems only; the system is classified as limited risk.
Raw user messages (including emails and order numbers, as the inline comment notes) are sent unmodified to the third-party model provider together with the full history.
gaps: No PII redaction before the LLM call.
Entire transcript history is forwarded on every turn.
verdicts.remediation: Add a redaction step (emails, phone numbers, addresses) before building the prompt and cap history to the last N turns.

verdicts.rationale: Session data in Redis expires after 30 days, but transcripts in Postgres are only inserted and never deleted or anonymised.
gaps: No retention/deletion for the transcripts table.
verdicts.remediation: Add a scheduled job deleting transcripts older than the retention period stated in the privacy notice, or a created_at-based partition drop.

verdicts.rationale: A privacy notice linked from the chat names the controller, purposes and recipients, but omits the legal basis and gives no concrete retention period.
verdicts.remediation: State the legal basis (Art. 6(1)(b)/(f)) and the concrete retention period in web/pages/privacy.mdx.

verdicts.rationale: The Postgres flexible server holding transcripts uses a customer-managed Key Vault key for encryption at rest.
Secrets are referenced via environment variables; .env.example contains empty placeholders only.
The chat_turn log line includes the raw prompt and answer. Whether the logger has a redaction transport configured elsewhere could not be established from the retrieved evidence.
gaps: Raw prompts appear in application logs.
verdicts.remediation: Configure pino redaction paths for prompt/answer or log message lengths and hashed session ids only.

evidence.snippet:
# Privacy notice

Northwind Traders Ltd. ("we") processes the messages you send to our
support assistant to answer your questions and improve our service.

**What we collect:** chat messages, order numbers you provide, technical
session identifiers.

**Who receives it:** our hosting provider and our AI model provider.

**How long:** see our retention schedule.

Contact: privacy@northwind.example

# copy to .env and fill from 1Password
OPENAI_API_KEY=
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379
DATABASE_URL=postgres://localhost:5432/chat
CHAT_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini

# EU AI Act self-assessment

The support assistant answers questions about orders, shipping and
returns. It does not take decisions about customers and escalates to a
human agent on request ("talk to a human").

Classification: **limited risk** (Art. 50 transparency obligations).
Not an Annex III use case. No prohibited practice under Art. 5.
